_about: How to Play pages: title, picture (a drawn picture, or put assets/howto/<picture>.png to use your own, 292x100), and paragraphs.

pages.title: GOAL
text: Destroy the enemy HQ. Nothing else wins.
Each HQ has 100 HP and never moves. It can attack enemies next door, and it always fires back.
You start with your HQ and one half-track. Green goes first; its very first turn is deploy only (no march, no attack).

pages.title: OUTPOSTS
text: Outposts are the stops on the map. One is yours while any of your units stand on it; leave it empty and it belongs to nobody again.
March onto an empty outpost to take it. You can never move onto an enemy outpost: clear it out first.

pages.title: STEP 1 OF 3: GATHER
text: You get 1 soldier, plus 1 for every barracks you hold.
Place them on your outposts, or on an empty outpost joined to yours by a road. The glowing rings show where.
Timer on? Soldiers you have not placed when it runs out are lost.

pages.title: BUYING VEHICLES
text: After placing, you may build ONE vehicle. Pay with soldiers standing on the same outpost; the vehicle appears right there.
Your most hurt soldiers pay first, and the vehicle always arrives at full HP. New vehicles can march and attack that same turn.

pages.title: STEP 2 OF 3: MARCH
text: Once per turn: pick one of your outposts, choose who goes, then pick a glowing destination.
A group moves as far as its slowest unit, only along roads and bridges, and never through enemy outposts.
Helicopters alone fly anywhere: over rivers and over the enemy.

pages.title: STEP 3 OF 3: ATTACK
text: Every unit may attack once, at an enemy outpost next door, even across a river.
Pick an attacker and a target. Both fire at the same time, each dealing random damage from its range.
Wipe out an outpost and you may move in for free (ESC hides that choice while you look around).

pages.title: WHO BEATS WHO
text: Tanks can never hit helicopters, so a helicopter attacks a tank with no return fire.
Half-tracks are anti-air: 1.5x damage against helicopters.
Hurt units hit just as hard as healthy ones.

pages.title: UNITS
text: DMG: damage per shot. MOVE: outposts per march. SIGHT: how far it sees in fog. COST: soldiers paid to build it.
Soldiers are free and arrive every turn.

pages.title: DAMAGE CHART
text: Rows attack, columns get hit. 8.5 ×3 means one shot does 8.5 damage on average, and it takes 3 hits to destroy a full-health target.
YELLOW: bonus damage. RED: can't hit at all. A hurt unit hits just as hard as a healthy one.

pages.title: TERRAIN
text: ROADS and BRIDGES: anyone can cross.
RIVERS: only helicopters cross, but anyone can shoot across one.
FORESTS and MOUNTAINS: nobody crosses or shoots across them.
BARRACKS (+1 badge): one more soldier every turn you hold it.

pages.title: FOG OF WAR
text: FOG (left): you see the map, but enemy units only within your sight. BLACKOUT (right): you see nothing beyond your sight, not even the map.
Sight: 1 outpost for soldiers, tanks and HQ, 2 for half-tracks, 3 for helicopters. You can only march where you can see.

pages.title: CONTROLS
text: ESC backs out of menus and choices. On the map it opens the menu: skip march, end turn, volume, resign, quit.
ESC also pauses the game during the CPU turn (you can change the volume there too).

pages.title: MAP EDITOR
text: Pick MAP EDITOR on the title screen. ARROWS move over outposts and the links between them; ENTER changes what is there, or picks up an HQ to move it.
MIRROR copies each edit to the other side, so maps stay fair. The editor menu (UP from the top row, or ESC) has a step-by-step guide: HOW IT WORKS.

pages.title: COMMANDERS
text: The GREEN COMMANDER leads Green and the TAN GENERAL leads Tan.
Watch their faces: they cheer a kill, wince when hit, get angry when their HQ takes fire, and look gloomy when they lose a unit.

pages.title: TIPS
text: Grab barracks early: they snowball.
Tank spam loses to helicopters; helicopter spam loses to half-tracks.
Sitting back loses. Attack!
